An evening of Port Said’s beloved semsemeya music is on its way. The date will be announced as soon as it is confirmed.

CodeDock, the new tech startup hub, secures its place in our rental offices

The hub, built for technical startups, has taken its seat in the Isthmus rental offices. Alongside the move, the latest data center updates bring expanded capacity and stronger connectivity for resident teams.
